text: Error ERR-5034 means the payment gateway timed out while confirming a charge. Retry the payment after 30 seconds or contact billing support.
Error ERR-5035 means the webhook signature could not be verified. Regenerate the signing secret in the developer settings.
Error ERR-4012 is returned when an API key has expired. Create a new key from the dashboard and update your integration.
Error ERR-4290 means the rate limit was exceeded. Wait for the retry-after period before sending more requests.
Error ERR-5101 indicates the search index is rebuilding. Queries resume automatically within ten minutes.
SKU DZ-TEAM-25 is the Team plan at 25 dollars per user per month with a limit of 50 seats.
SKU DZ-START-10 is the Starter plan at 10 dollars per user per month with a limit of 5 seats.
SKU DZ-ENT-CUSTOM is the Enterprise plan with custom pricing, unlimited seats and a dedicated account manager.
Clause 7.2 of the master services agreement limits liability to the fees paid in the previous twelve months.
Clause 9.4 of the master services agreement requires thirty days written notice to terminate the contract.
Clause 11.1 of the master services agreement describes how personal data is processed and where it is stored.
To reset your password, open the login page, choose Forgot password and follow the link sent to your email.
Two factor authentication can be enabled in account settings using an authenticator app or a hardware key.
Annual billing gives a fifteen percent discount on every plan. Invoices are emailed on the first day of the billing period.
Refunds for annual plans are available within fourteen days of purchase. Monthly plans are not refunded.
The customer support team is available Monday to Friday from 9 AM to 6 PM IST. Urgent incidents are handled by the on-call engineer.
Every support ticket receives a first response within four working hours. Escalations go to the support lead.
Employees receive twenty days of paid leave per year and may carry over five unused days.
Sick leave does not count against annual leave, but a medical note is required after three consecutive days.
Customer data is encrypted at rest with AES-256 and in transit with TLS 1.3.
Report any suspected security incident to the security team immediately so the response process starts within the hour.
The ingestion pipeline accepts PDF, Markdown, HTML and Word documents and splits them into token-bounded chunks.
Scanned PDFs need optical character recognition before they can be indexed.
Invite teammates from the settings page. Each invitation link expires after forty-eight hours.
Single sign-on with SAML is available on the Enterprise plan only.
The public API allows 30 requests per minute per key by default. Higher limits are available on request.
Data export produces a ZIP file with all documents and metadata and is ready within one hour.
Deleted documents are permanently removed from search results and backups after ninety days.
Dashboards show query latency, token usage and cost per tenant for the last thirty days.
The mobile app supports offline reading of saved documents on iOS and Android.
